description: Find hand-checked local makers on Pinmade: shops that design and make their own things (clothing, leather, ceramics, crafts…) with a place you can walk into. Filter by words, category, place, distance and open now. Returns each shop's page link, address, opening hours and what they make.

open_now.description: Only shops open right now (their local time)

radius_km.description: Distance from lat/lng in km (default 5, max 50)

name: search_shops
title: Search local makers
